partner_info.impression_f: The last time I was alone at home and running a fever, Trigger unexpectedly showed up at the store. Without even checking my temperature, she knew I had a fever of 38.6 and took care of me the whole afternoon... How did she know?
partner_info.impression_m: Are you asking how she knew you had a fever, or how she knew the exact temperature? I'm not sure either, but a little while ago when I sprained my ankle in the parking lot, she showed up with an ice pack almost immediately...
impressions:
Impressions of Trigger:
 · Well-mannered, gentle, perceptive, and dependable — these are the qualities that best sum up the first impression Trigger leaves on people.
· Our bond with Trigger started early on, and she appears to view this past experience as her most cherished memory.
· She's a bit too invested in our plans, orchestrating random encounters in every way possible... Seems this is the true face of this ace sniper.
partner_info.profile_desc:
Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.

She has extremely unique eyes. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.

As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.

In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless.
unlock_condition: Complete Main Story Season 1 - Epilogue "Bury Your Tears With the Past (A)"

trust_lv.3:
According to records, Trigger originally served in the Lyre Squad of the Eridu Defense Force, Chrysoberyl Division. The other members of the squad were all killed during the fall of the old capital. Her eyes were also corrupted during this disaster. Trigger is currently working alongside the other members of her new squad to investigate the truth behind the fall of the old capital.

Trigger has a deep sense of loyalty to her companions, willing to go to great lengths for them. Master, from her actions, it is evident that she considers you a companion and has a noticeably high level of affection for you. It is likely that some event has occurred, which has left a strong, positive impression on her.

Suggestion: Offering unlimited red bean buns and round-the-clock access to soundproof rooms for harmonica playing as conditions, try negotiating a long-term partnership. This would enable you to secure extremely dependable combat strength with minimal expenditure.

description.name: Basic Attack: Cold-Bore Shot
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, the 4th hit deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

description.name: Basic Attack: Silenced Shot
description.desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Trigger enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> and fires forward continuously, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

description.name: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot
description.desc:
When Trigger has <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The squad can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> once every 3s.

description.name: Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus
description.desc:
When Trigger has <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy attack from an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The same skill type can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> will immediately activate instead if triggered.

description.name: Dodge: Phantom Concealment
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Dash Attack: Vengeful Specter
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly lift the gun and fire, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Condemned Soul
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Spectral Flash
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Flash Burial
description.desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

description.name: Chain Attack: Stygian Guide
description.desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Underworld Requiem
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

description.name: Quick Assist: Cold-Bore Cover Fire
description.desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Delaying Demise
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Piercing Thunder
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, followed by a powerful charged shot after landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1.name: Sharpened Senses
1.desc: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze</color> is increased by an additional 20%. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> increases by 25%. Maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> increases to 125.
1.desc2:
Hearing that can distinguish every subtle change in the wind, touch that can sense every tremor in the ground. To compensate for her visual limitations, the young lady honed her other senses to perfection.
"Being a sniper is the only thing I excel at... At least in this, I refuse to lose to anyone."

2.name: "Ether Vision"
2.desc: Upon using an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, Trigger gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. When executing a Finishing Move in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, Trigger gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gaze</color> increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
2.desc2:
When inside the Hollow, every Ether fluctuation around her becomes an aid to her spatial observation.
"I used to think these eyes were cursed, bringing nothing but pain."
"But now... they're my ticket to reaching my goals, and proof that I haven't forgotten my past."

3.name: "Homecoming"
3.desc2:
The home she could return to is now sealed away in the past.
Her cold lips pressed against the harmonica, the lonely melody the only testament to her memories.

4.name: Concealment
4.desc: When Trigger enters or extends <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disconnect</color> upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.
4.desc2:
Footsteps, breaths, heartbeats. She smothers every trace of her own aura until her entire form blends seamlessly with the environment. She moves through the battlefield like a ghostly reaper.
Outside of combat though, this silent way of moving has been strictly forbidden after scaring her teammates one too many times.
Of course, she definitely hasn't been using these stealth tactics to observe the video store when she can't find an opportunity to meet someone there... right?

5.name: Locked In
5.desc2:
Once a target is locked, even with a broken, decaying body or through excruciating pain, never let your crosshair waver. From the targets of her revenge to those she must protect, from enemies to allies — this is the will of a sniper.
But with the Proxy, the one who gave her light in her darkest hour, it's not about locking in but being drawn in. Even if there's no reason to keep watching, she will never divert her aim — this is the will of a young lady.

6.name: Beyond the River of the Dead
6.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>. For every 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color>, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Rounds</color>, when Trigger hits a target in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> is consumed to deal additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. <color=#FFFFFF>Armor Break Round</color> DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
6.desc2:
"You know what? Those who are stained with blood in battle can only go to the underworld after death."
"Beyond the river of the dead lies a sight of unparalleled beauty. Flowers bloom all around me, while familiar faces from my past accompany me to my final, peaceful place of rest."
"But... because of you, because I have something to protect, perhaps I don't want that day to come so soon."

3113610.name: Trigger: Gaze Into the Light
3113610.desc: In the Hollows, her aim never wavers. She's a teammate one can rely on to cover their back without question. But once she returns to Sixth Street, that constant watchfulness softens, lingering for a moment before disappearing the instant it's sensed.
